topic: Measuring Mass and Temperature with Appropriate Units
key_concepts: Mass is measured with a balance or weighing scale
Temperature is measured with a thermometer in degrees Celsius
Appropriate mass units include milligrams, grams, and kilograms
Small objects like pills are measured in milligrams
Heavy materials like cement are measured in kilograms
Everyday objects like sharpeners are measured in grams
Manual scales are read by the position of the hand
Electronic balances display the mass on a screen
Thermometer liquid expands when exposed to matter
Small divisions on a thermometer can represent 0.1°C
Submerge thermometer without touching the container bottom
